description: Claude 3 Sonnet is Anthropic's balanced model offering a combination of capability and speed. It provides strong performance at a moderate cost, suitable for enterprise workloads requiring efficiency.

trainingData.description: Trained on a diverse corpus of text and image data using Constitutional AI (CAI) methods.

trainingProcedure: Trained using Constitutional AI (CAI) and Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF).

evaluation.performanceSummary: Balanced performance between Opus and Haiku. Good for tasks requiring moderate capability with reasonable speed and cost.

knownLimitations: Less capable than Opus on complex reasoning tasks
Superseded by Claude 3.5 Sonnet for most use cases
May generate incorrect or misleading information

ethicalConsiderations.biasAndFairness: Anthropic uses Constitutional AI to reduce harmful outputs and biases.
ethicalConsiderations.safetyMeasures: Constitutional AI training and content filtering.
ethicalConsiderations.privacyConsiderations: API data is not used to train models by default.

access.status: Available but superseded by Claude 3.5 Sonnet

requirements.deployment: API-only (cloud-hosted by Anthropic), also available via AWS Bedrock and Google Cloud Vertex AI
